prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one complete full-bleed portrait 2:3 tarot illustration, Five of Cups. The first 1 reference image(s) are exact Dragon Quest character identity/costume references; the LAST is ONLY the approved deck ink/color/texture style, not a scene or person to copy.
Scene and exact characters: Actual DQVIII transformed King Trode: small green humanoid with pointed ears, unruly pale green hair, small purple lips, orange hooded robe/coat. He stands wistfully beside a stream with lowered head. Exactly FIVE golden chalices: THREE knocked over in front with spilled water, TWO upright just behind him within easy reach. A small stone bridge and warm light in distance give hope; sadness but no danger. Do not include reference writing/parchment/background or any additional cup.
Shared deck art direction: faithfully drawn Akira Toriyama Dragon Quest characters, clean confident black ink outlines, expressive recognizable faces, crisp hand-painted cel color blocks, restrained shadows and a subtle watercolor-paper grain matching the approved illustration. Original illustration, NOT a 3D screenshot, product photograph, plush, collage or card mockup. Full-bleed single cohesive artwork edge to edge, mobile-readable clear silhouettes and large key symbols.
Hard constraints: no title, no typography, no letters or numerals, no UI, no watermark/logo, no borders or card frame. Any writing, decorative labels, copyright line, duplicate background portraits or layout boxes on reference sheets must NOT appear. Preserve actual named DQ characters, hairstyle/clothing/colors, not generic original substitutes. Keep the stated number of tarot objects exact; avoid incidental extra cups/swords/coins/wands. Do not mix in characters from other franchises.
visual_review: King Trode retains green creature identity and orange robe. Exactly three spilled cups in foreground plus two standing cups behind him, five total; no typography/frame and consistent style.
